title: Geothermal Ordinance Extraction Schema
description: Schema for extracting geothermal zoning ordinance requirements and regulations from jurisdictional documents. Extract data exactly as written in the ordinance. Do not infer or normalize values beyond standardizing date formats and units.

jurisdictionDetails.description: Jurisdiction-level metadata extracted exactly from the document. Do not infer or normalize.

state.description: State name exactly as written in the ordinance (e.g., 'California', 'Nevada', 'Utah'). Do not abbreviate unless the ordinance uses abbreviations.

county.description: County name exactly as written in the ordinance (e.g., 'Imperial County', 'Lyon County', 'Iron County'). Include 'County' designation if present in the document.

city.description: City or municipality name exactly as written in the ordinance if applicable. Leave null if ordinance is county-level or no city is specified.

jurisdictionName.description: Full official name of the jurisdiction exactly as written in the document header or title (e.g., 'Board of Supervisors of the County of Imperial, State of California'). Leave null if not explicitly stated.

ordinanceTitle.description: Full title of the ordinance or code section exactly as written in the document (e.g., 'TITLE 9 - BUILDING, PLANNING AND LAND USE - DIVISION 17 - GEOTHERMAL ORDINANCE', 'Chapter 26.138 - Geothermal Exploration and Development'). Include chapter, title, and division numbers as they appear. Leave null if not stated.

ordinanceNumber.description: Ordinance number or code section identifier exactly as written (e.g., 'Ordinance No. 1291', 'Chapter 90701-13', 'Section 26.138'). Extract the primary identifier without labels. Leave null if not stated.

ordinanceDate.description: Date the ordinance was enacted, adopted, or last amended in YYYY-MM-DD format if unambiguous. Convert dates like 'October 6, 2015' → '2015-10-06', 'May 1979' → '1979-05-01', or year-only like '1979' → '1979-01-01'. If only year is provided, use January 1st. Leave null if not stated.

effectiveDate.description: Effective date of the ordinance in YYYY-MM-DD format if explicitly stated and different from ordinanceDate. Leave null if not stated or same as ordinanceDate.

documentSource.description: Source reference exactly as written (e.g., 'Municipal Code', 'County Code', website URL if shown in document). Leave null if not stated.

extractionNotes.description: Optional notes for documenting jurisdiction-level extraction decisions. Use ONLY when: (1) multiple dates exist and you selected the primary one; (2) ambiguity in jurisdiction name or ordinance title required clarification; (3) date format was ambiguous. Leave null if extraction was straightforward.

ordinanceRequirements.description: Array of ordinance requirements. Extract each distinct requirement as a separate entry. List in order they appear in the document. Do not consolidate requirements even if they are related.

items.description: One entry per ordinance requirement (e.g., noise limit, setback distance, fencing requirement).

feature.description: Type of requirement exactly as categorized in the ordinance. Use the most specific enum value that matches. If ordinance uses different terminology, select the closest match and document in extractionNotes.

value.description: Numeric value exactly as stated in the ordinance, OR 'Yes'/'No' for boolean requirements. Extract the number without units (units go in the 'unit' field). For ranges, extract as written (e.g., '500-1000'). For complex values, use the 'notes' field and put the simplified numeric value here. Examples: '55 dBA' → value: '55', unit: 'dBA'; 'Yes, required' → value: 'Yes', unit: null; '300 feet from property lines' → value: '300', unit: 'feet'. Leave null if requirement is qualitative only.

unit.description: Unit of measurement exactly as written in the ordinance (e.g., 'dBA', 'feet', 'acres', 'miles', 'meters', 'hours'). Common units: 'dBA' or 'dB' for noise, 'feet' or 'meters' for distances/heights, 'acres' for areas, 'hours' for time periods. Leave null if value is boolean (Yes/No) or dimensionless.

notes.description: Additional details, qualifiers, or context about the requirement exactly as written in the ordinance. Examples: 'at property line', 'during daytime hours (7am-10pm)', 'measured at nearest residence', 'with County approval', 'for exploratory wells only', 'renewable annually'. Capture conditions, exceptions, measurement methods, time periods, or other qualifying language. This field is critical for understanding the full context of numeric values. Leave null if no additional context is provided.

sourceSection.description: Specific ordinance section, subsection, or paragraph where this requirement appears (e.g., 'Section 90701.7', 'Chapter 26.138.050(B)(3)', 'Division 17, Article 3'). Extract exactly as referenced in the document. Leave null if not identifiable.

applicability.description: To what this requirement applies if specified (e.g., 'exploratory wells', 'production wells', 'all geothermal facilities', 'power plants only', 'drilling operations'). Extract verbatim. Leave null if applies generally or not specified.

exemptions.description: Exemptions or exceptions to this requirement if stated (e.g., 'except with variance approval', 'unless determined unnecessary by County', 'excluding maintenance operations'). Extract verbatim. Leave null if no exemptions stated.

extractionNotes.description: Optional notes documenting extraction decisions for this specific requirement. Use ONLY when: (1) ordinance language was ambiguous and you made an interpretation; (2) multiple similar requirements existed and you needed to differentiate; (3) unit conversion was required; (4) feature category selection was uncertain. Leave null if extraction was straightforward.

metadata.description: Extraction metadata for quality tracking and audit purposes.

extractionDate.description: Date when extraction was performed in YYYY-MM-DD format.

documentType.description: Type of document (e.g., 'zoning ordinance', 'municipal code', 'county code', 'regulation'). Extract based on document self-description.

totalPages.description: Total number of pages in the source document if determinable.

confidence.description: Overall confidence in extraction quality. 'high' if document was clear and complete, 'medium' if some ambiguities existed, 'low' if document was difficult to interpret or incomplete.

extractionNotes.description: Overall notes about the extraction process, document quality issues, or limitations. Use for document-level observations like 'poor scan quality', 'partial document', 'multiple amendments referenced but not included', etc. Leave null if no issues.
